correctness.rationale: Petersen graph KG(5,2) has ten vertices indexed by two-element subsets and fifteen disjointness edges. The 2-matching complex has face condition graph-edge selection giving degree at most two at each of ten graph vertices. A fresh independently coded complete 2^15 subset enumeration obtained exactly 10,870 faces including empty, f-vector (15,105,445,1245,2358,2985,2400,1095,215,6). Repeated vertex-toggle matching on nonempty faces has 5,432 pairs and critical vector (one 0-cell, four 7-cells); independently oriented and topologically sorted all 63,780 Hasse arcs, confirming no directed cycles and hence wedge of four 7-spheres. For all 120 letter permutations, fresh reconstruction of the induced permutation on graph edges and cycle-wise invariant-face alternating sum matched fixed_letter_count−1. The Euler-chain trace equals signed trace on H7 since degree 7 contributes with a minus sign: reduced Lefschetz = -(fix(g)-1), so rational H7 character is exactly the standard S5 representation Q^5/Q. Identity gives dimension 4; all seven cycle classes are consistent. This establishes rational representation, not integral module isomorphism or an equivariant wedge structure.
residual_risks: The statement is about reduced rational H7 only; integral S5-lattice structure is not identified.
An acyclic nonequivariant matching does not alone determine a group action; independent signed fixed-face Lefschetz computations provide that step.
